adopt: Point it at a backend you already pay for and run one agent loop.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Running one agent is easy and running fifty is a different job: budgets, retries, which model, whose machine. Most frameworks make you adopt their whole world to find out.

Install
pip install awdk

Commands
  adk
  adk-bug
  adk-py
  adk-serve
  adk-shell
  adk-workspace
  aither-adk
  awdk

Quick start
  pip install awdk
  adk quickstart # auto-detect hardware, set up inference
  adk init my-agent && cd my-agent && python agent.py

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/
